title: Curation Conductor for Jurisdictional Privacy Asks and Runtime SLA Mapping
creator: Aisha Morales
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit heterogeneous security & compliance asks (vendor questionnaires, DPAs, SOC2/ISO checklists, HIPAA/GDPR constraints) that are currently triaged manually by Solutions and Legal. That manual path is slow, error-prone, and often routes asks to the wrong product lane (hosted vs dedicated vs private) causing rework and missed SLAs.

  Goal: Build an automated 'Curation Conductor' that analyzes incoming compliance requests, maps them to jurisdictional and runtime impact (data residency, encryption/KMS, hosting mode, audit log needs), and outputs a scored routing recommendation and a pre-filled evidence pack template. The feature should reduce manual triage time, improve first-touch routing accuracy to the appropriate product lane (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), and provide a clear audit trail for Legal/Customer Success.

  Scope (MVP):
  - Intake enhancement: structured fields + free-text parser that extracts jurisdiction, data categories, required certifications, and contractual asks.
  - Decision rules engine: rule-set mapping asks to routing lanes and urgency buckets; includes jurisdictional overrides (e.g., GDPR data residency request -> Private or Dedicated with EU region).
  - Evidence templates: per-certification and per-ask checklist that auto-populates links to console artifacts (SOC2 report location, encryption docs, data flow diagrams).
  - Console UI: a triage suggestion panel for PM/Support to accept/adjust routing with a confidence score and rationale.
  - Audit logs: immutable decision record stored on ticket for compliance reviews.
acceptance_criteria: Incoming compliance intake returns a recommended routing lane (hosted|dedicated|private) with a confidence score and top-3 rationale points.
Evidence template generator produces a downloadable zip containing a checklist and links to relevant artifacts for SOC2, ISO, HIPAA, GDPR and typical DPA asks.
Triage UI shows the parsed metadata (jurisdiction, data categories, requested certifications) and allows edit + accept by CS/PM with change reason logged.
Routing accuracy on the pilot accounts improves to >= 85% (manual audit of 100 recent tickets) compared to baseline 60% within 1 month of pilot.
Decision engine records an auditable decision object (timestamp, versioned-rule-id, inputs, outputs) attached to the Linear ticket.
Unit and integration tests cover parsing edge-cases, rule fallbacks, and export generation; e2e smoke validates UI flow and audit log attach.
Privacy/Legal sign-off on the mapping rules and evidence templates prior to GA launch.
tasks: Define canonical taxonomy for jurisdictional asks (GDPR, CPRA, UK-GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2, ISO) with Legal and Solutions
Workshop decision rule matrix: jurisdiction x data category x contractual ask -> recommended hosting mode + urgency
Design intake UX: structured fields, parser warning highlights, and triage suggestion panel (Design leads: Mei Chen)
Implement lightweight NLP parser prototype (ENG) and wire to rule engine - create fallback for low confidence
Build evidence template generator and map to existing docs (SOC2 report location, KMS docs, audit logs, datacatalog links)
Add audit log object to ticket model and ensure immutable append semantics
Pilot the flow with 10 enterprise accounts (Solutions + CS) and collect feedback metrics
Create runbook for handling conflicts between rule engine and Legal overrides
Prepare training materials for CS and Solutions on the new triage UI
